info.title: Hapti API
info.description: Hapti does tasks on websites that have no API: an agent operates a real browser by sight, like a person, and returns the result with proof. You pay for each action of the agent that worked, whatever the outcome; failed actions are free.

post.description: Starts an agent that does the goal on the website, by sight, in a real browser. Returns at once; follow the task with GET, the live stream or webhooks.

post.description: Checks a website on a schedule with a task, compares each result with the previous one and sends monitor.changed only when something was added, removed or changed. Takes the fields of a task (url, goal, output, user, data, files...) plus every or cron.

key.description: The field that names an item of the list, like url or reference; a dotted path works. Without it an item is known by its content.

notify.description: changes (default): monitor.changed only. always: also monitor.checked after every check.

webhook.description: An https address that receives this monitor's events, besides your webhook endpoints

run_now.description: true by default: the first check runs at once and sets the starting value

get.description: Server-Sent Events: a task event each time a task of the mode changes state.
The organisation and mode of the key.
The credit left and the prices.
Every version and what it changed, with the one your organisation is pinned to.

changes: A live task without enough credit is created paused and starts by itself once credit is added (on_insufficient_credit: refuse keeps the 402).
Lists are paged with has_more, next_cursor and total.
price_cents is what was billed, 0 until a live task succeeds; starting_price_cents gives the starting price.
A live task without enough credit is refused with 402 insufficient_credit.

get.description: Tasks learnt from successes and replayed faster and cheaper.
Every request made with a key of the mode in the last 30 days, secrets masked.

bearer.description: An API key: hp_test_ for tests that never submit your data, hp_live_ for real tasks.

TaskInput.description: Give url and goal, or a catalogue template and its params.

goal.description: What to achieve and what to report back, in plain words, in any language.

data.description: The facts the agent may use. It never invents a missing value: it asks.

template.description: A catalogue template id, instead of url and goal.

user.description: The person the task acts for. Gives the task their device, session, memory, inbox and stored accounts.

accounts.description: Stored accounts of the person the agent may sign in with.

output.description: A JSON Schema for result.data. A task whose answer cannot follow it ends incomplete.

files.description: Files the agent may upload on the site: up to 20, 50 MB each, 100 MB in all.

webhook.description: An https address that receives the events of this task only.

approval.description: required: the agent waits for your approval before any step that commits the person.

max_price_cents.description: The agent stops before the price would go over it.

answer_language.description: Language of the answer and questions, like fr, pt-BR or wo. By default, the language of the goal.

takeover.description: Let the person take over the browser when the agent needs them for a step (a code in their bank app, a check it cannot pass, a sign-in only they can do): the task waits with pending.type takeover and a live page in pending.action_url, then the agent goes on. true waits up to 15 minutes; {"minutes": 1 to 60} sets the wait. Off by default: without it the task ends with needs_person_action.

mock.description: Test keys only: the task answers at once with this outcome, opens no browser and is never billed. succeeded, failed, blocked, incomplete, needs_person, question, approval, or an object with status, data, answer, reason and delay_ms. See Test your integration.

locale.description: Language of the browser, like pt-PT.

country.description: Two letters: the country the sites see the person in.

proxy.description: Go out through a residential address in that country, billed per GB used.

memory.description: true by default with a user.

keep_session.description: true by default with a user: the task opens the person's own browser profile as their last task left it (cookies, site storage, sign-ins) and saves it at the end. false starts a clean browser.

learn.description: true by default: a success becomes a recipe.

on_insufficient_credit.description: pause by default: a live task without enough credit waits and starts once credit is added.

pending.description: What the agent waits for: a question or an approval, with an action_url the person can use without an account.

answer.description: What the agent reports, in plain words

data.description: Follows the output schema of the request

reason.description: Set when the task did not succeed. A stable code: site_unreachable, blocked_by_site, needs_sign_in, not_found, needs_person_action, cannot_continue, out_of_time, out_of_steps, no_progress, output_mismatch, account_unavailable, credit or engine_error. Treat an unknown code like cannot_continue.

message.description: The reason in one plain sentence, to show people

error.description: Raw technical detail, for debugging only

price_cents.description: What was billed: $0.10 per started 10 actions that worked, whatever the outcome; 0 while the task runs and when no action worked.

paused.description: Why the task waits for credit: since, stops_at, add_credit_at, offered_cents (the credit a first card brings, 0 when there is none), how and message, ready to show to the person

started_at.description: When a browser first took the task; null while it waits in the queue or for credit

scope.description: What the agent may do for the person.

given_by.description: Who gave it, or how the person agreed.

events.description: Event types, a family like user.*, or ["*"] for every event, including future ones.

headers.description: Up to 10 headers sent with each delivery.

secret.description: Only when created, rolled or revealed.

error.message: url: an http or https address is required, or device for a task on a computer

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing or not valid

error.message: a valid key is required: Authorization: Bearer hp_live_… or hp_test_…

Conflict.description: The object is not in a state that allows this

RateLimited.description: Too many requests: wait for Retry-After seconds

InsufficientCredit.description: Not enough credit, with on_insufficient_credit set to refuse
